own_solution.law: Coulomb's law and conservation of charge. For initial charges +5Q and -Q, each identical sphere has charge +2Q after contact. Thus F1 = 80*(4/5)*(30/60)^2 = 16 mN. An additional separation x gives F(x) = 16*[60/(60+x)]^2 mN, with x in centimetres.
assumptions: Contact establishes electrostatic equilibrium, sharing the conserved charge equally between identical spheres.
The explicitly prescribed point-charge model applies.
The distant wooden blocks do not disturb the field within the stated idealization.
The earlier experiment precedes the fully specified initial state.
